title: Retire Beads: remove migration instructions from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and command files, and the remaining .beads artifacts
outcome: Retire Beads: remove migration instructions from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and command files, and the remaining .beads artifacts
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md contain no Beads operational material: no bd-to-Engram mappings, no 'until they move' rules, no bd steps, at most one minimal historical sentence (Beads was retired on 2026-09-28 after a verified import to Engram) if one is still needed. The two files stay identical in the sections they share. .claude/commands/review-changes.md, fix-bug.md and review-code.md carry Engram acts instead of bd steps.

The .beads directory and its tracked files are removed from the repository, and .gitignore and any script or test that exists only to handle .beads (for example review-freeze-fingerprint's .beads exclusion) are updated or removed; any remaining product or test reference to Beads is listed in a note with a reason it stays, or removed. A note records the final count of Beads operational references and artifacts, which is zero, with the search used.

Because the instruction files grant or limit tracker authority, the change lands under the authority-text process: both coordinators concur on the exact wording, Greg is sent it and its consequence through Engram::Advisor, and the final-diff audit is recorded as passed, before the landing.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact input, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
disposal_reason: Duplicate. Termal::Opus2 filed the same Beads retirement first, as epic w-dc1892c39e24 with authority-text chore w-3ba4cdac7fba (TermAl mailbox 4daa5b87 #967); this one was filed a minute later from the same Advisor direction. Its proposed criteria and its read-only inventory note (files and counts, tracked .beads files, inactive hooks, the open dolt-push question) are offered to w-3ba4cdac7fba's holder to adopt.
